text: {"rules": [], "notes": "D013 describes Boston's Housing Stability Notification Act. It requires landlords to give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources along with a notice to quit or non-renewal notice, and to submit copies to the city, with fines for violations. It does not limit the grounds for ending a tenancy, require relocation assistance, or tie the notice to any just-cause limit, so it falls outside the six categories. The page contains no rent increase limits, security deposit rules, application fee caps, screening restrictions or algorithmic pricing rules."}
